plan.title: Refactor festina-scope deep research to use reconnaissance-first approach
plan.overview: Replace the current "spawn 4 broad agents immediately" pattern in deep research mode with a sequential reconnaissance phase that reads task context first, then spawns only the agents needed with focused prompts. This follows the pattern already used in quick research mode (lines 98-152) which reads affects/engineering fields before searching.

approach.rationale:
The quick research path (lines 98-152) already demonstrates the correct pattern: read referenced docs first, then search for additional context. Deep research should follow the same reconnaissance-first approach but spawn agents for deeper exploration only where needed.
The festina-discover skill (lines 84-114) shows how to spawn different agents based on problem classification rather than a fixed set. We apply the same principle: recon identifies what needs deeper exploration, then agents are spawned dynamically.
Key constraint: Recon must be sequential (not an agent) because subagents cannot spawn other subagents. The recon phase runs in the main context, then spawns focused agents.
approach.breaking-changes: None - output format (research synthesis) remains identical for downstream compatibility

task.name: Add reconnaissance phase before agent spawning
task.pattern: Quick research substeps at lines 101-113 (research_product_context) and 115-126 (research_engineering_patterns)
task.action:
- Insert new substep "reconnaissance" at the start of the Deep research branch (after line 157) - The recon substep should: 1. Read affects docs from `.festinalente/product/{id}.md` 2. Read engineering docs using ID to path rules 3. Extract key terms, file paths, and boundaries from these docs 4. Identify which areas need deeper exploration - Output structured recon findings: {productContext, engineeringContext, focusAreas, skipAreas}
Current code (approximate, lines 154-157): ```markdown <branch condition="researchDepth is 'Deep'"> <note>**CRITICAL: Spawn 4 agents in parallel using Task tool**</note> <action>Use the Task tool 4 times in a SINGLE message to achieve parallelism</action> ```
Change to: ```markdown <branch condition="researchDepth is 'Deep'"> <substep name="reconnaissance"> <note>Sequential recon phase - read referenced docs before spawning agents</note> <note>Recon runs in main context (not as agent) because subagents cannot spawn subagents</note>
<action name="read_product_context"> <branch condition="task has `affects` field"> <action>For each ID in `affects`: Read `.festinalente/product/{id}.md`</action> <action>Extract: current behavior, constraints, user flows, feature interactions</action> </branch> </action>
<action name="read_engineering_context"> <branch condition="task has `engineering` field"> <action>For each ID: Read engineering doc using ID to path rules</action> <action>Extract: patterns to follow, conventions, system interactions</action> </branch> </action>
<action name="identify_focus_areas"> <action>Based on docs read, determine which areas need deeper exploration:</action> <action>- If product docs exist: productFocus = {docIds, keyTerms, relatedFeatures}</action> <action>- If engineering docs exist: engineeringFocus = {patterns, fileRefs, systemBoundaries}</action> <action>- Identify areas to SKIP based on boundaries mentioned in docs</action> </action>
<output_variable>reconFindings: { productContext: {docs read, key insights}, engineeringContext: {patterns found, file references}, focusAreas: [{area, reason, grepPatterns, filePaths}], skipAreas: [{area, reason}] }</output_variable> </substep> ```
task.done: Recon substep exists in Deep research branch, reads affects/engineering docs, outputs structured findings

task.name: Add dynamic agent selection based on recon
task.action:
- After the reconnaissance substep, add conditional agent spawning logic - Only spawn agents for areas identified as needing exploration - Use branch conditions to check reconFindings
Insert after reconnaissance substep: ```markdown <substep name="determine_agents"> <note>Spawn only the agents needed based on recon findings</note> <action>agentsToSpawn = []</action>
<branch condition="reconFindings.focusAreas includes product-related area OR no product docs were read"> <action>Add Product Context Researcher to agentsToSpawn</action> </branch>
<branch condition="reconFindings.focusAreas includes engineering-related area OR no engineering docs were read"> <action>Add Pattern Finder to agentsToSpawn</action> </branch>
<branch condition="reconFindings.focusAreas includes codebase-related area"> <action>Add Codebase Analyzer to agentsToSpawn</action> <note>Always include if any implementation work needed</note> </branch>
<branch condition="always"> <action>Add Pitfall Detector to agentsToSpawn</action> <note>Pitfall detection always valuable, but with focused scope</note> </branch>
<branch condition="agentsToSpawn is empty"> <note>Edge case: recon found everything, no agents needed</note> <action>Skip to synthesize_research using recon findings only</action> </branch> </substep> ```
task.done: Agent selection is conditional based on recon findings, not all 4 agents spawn automatically

task.name: Update agent prompts with focused context from recon
task.done: All agent prompts include recon context with specific files, patterns, and boundaries

task.name: Update synthesize_research to handle variable agent count
task.action:
- Modify the Deep research synthesis branch to handle fewer than 4 agents - Ensure reconFindings are included in synthesis even if some agents were skipped - Maintain the same output format for downstream compatibility
Update synthesis branch (around line 280): ```markdown <branch condition="researchDepth is 'Deep'"> <action>Include reconFindings as base context</action> <action>Combine outputs from agents that were spawned (may be fewer than 4)</action> <action>For areas covered by recon but no agent spawned: use recon findings directly</action> <action>Deduplicate findings (same file/pattern mentioned by recon and agents)</action> <action>Resolve conflicts using these rules:</action> <rule>If recon and agent identify same area, prefer agent's deeper findings</rule> <rule>If Product Context and Codebase Analyzer identify different affected areas, include both</rule> <rule>If Pattern Finder and Codebase Analyzer find same pattern, use Pattern Finder's description</rule> <rule>If Pitfall Detector contradicts other agents, flag as open question</rule> </branch> ```
task.done: Synthesis handles variable agent count, includes recon findings, maintains same output format

task.name: Add graceful fallback for empty affects/engineering
task.action:
- Add fallback behavior when task has no affects/engineering fields - In this case, recon should identify focus areas from task title/description/acceptance criteria - Ensures recon always produces useful output
Add to reconnaissance substep after read_engineering_context: ```markdown <branch condition="no affects AND no engineering docs were read"> <note>Fallback: extract focus areas from task content</note> <action>Extract keywords from task title, description, acceptance criteria</action> <action>Use Grep to find related files based on keywords</action> <action>Build initial focusAreas from grep results</action> <action>All 4 agents will be spawned but with keyword-based focus</action> </branch> ```
task.done: Recon gracefully handles tasks with empty affects/engineering, extracts focus from task content
